tool.name: ATAS
tool.description: ATAS is order-flow software for futures, stocks and crypto, with footprint charts, heatmaps and volume tools. The current apps run on Windows, macOS and the web.
features: Footprint charts, volume profile and a heatmap
Connections to crypto, futures and stock data, with real-time access depending on the plan
A free Start plan, plus a 14-day trial of paid plans

plans.name: Start
plans.detail: Basic tools, with no time limit, according to the pricing FAQ.

plans.name: Plus
plans.detail: Monthly price. Longer terms were shown at a lower monthly equivalent.

plans.name: Pro
plans.detail: Monthly price. Real-time futures and stock connections are on this tier and above.

plans.name: Ultra
plans.detail: Monthly price. Includes the wider tool set described on the pricing page.

tool.pricing_note: Monthly euro prices from the official pricing page on 11 Oct 2026. Longer subscriptions cost less per month. Lifetime amounts were on the page but were not clearly tied to a plan name, so they are not listed.
